wt: A member of the lute family, there is perhaps no more emblematic instrument of the Islamic world than the oud. The defining characteristics of an oud are evident here: a pear-shaped body with a fretless fingerboard and a peg box set at a 45-to-90-degree angle to the neck.
The oud has influenced music traditions throughout the world by becoming the European lute, the Chinese pipa , and the Indonesian qanbūs .

Edmund Dulac was such a devoted Anglophile that as a student his contemporaries referred to him as "l'Anglais" (English).
